goal: Fixes a node crash when importing a watch-only descriptor with a range ending at 2^31-1
Also fixes the same crash when -keypool is set larger than INT32_MAX
Prevents a corrupted descriptor range from being persisted to the wallet database before the crash
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with several other open wallet PRs touching the same code
Code itself is already substantively reviewed and tested; rebase is the only remaining blocker
agreement: Verified by reproducing the crash on master and confirming the fix (molnard)
Verified by building and testing both the fix and its tests (kriss39)
Concept approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, vicjuma)
Follow-up ideas raised but explicitly agreed to be non-blocking (molnard)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because the bug crashes the node on a reproducible RPC call or startup config, an operator-facing denial of service
Also persists a corrupted descriptor range to disk before crashing, harming wallet state integrity
Fix also closes a related integer-overflow path in keypoolrefill reachable without any import
